title: The launcher's frame: the grip, receiver and barrel round the mechanism
description: The body's outline is the space; its bed wall and everything the flexures and the sled are fixed to are kept (the body's mounts); the flexures' sweeps, the slot, the magazine column and the trigger's room stay empty (its pockets). Held by the hand at the grip's front and back straps; loaded by the bow at full draw (its root pulled back, the sear's post pushed forward), and by a knock on the muzzle sideways (its weak direction; a downward knock and one on the magazine were tried as cases too, and dropped: each case is a solve a step, and this grid's thin kept bed wall under big pockets makes every solve slow). Printed lying on its bed wall, so z is the build direction.

build.rule: +z: only what prints without supports, lying on its bed wall; none: optimised freely

supports.label: the grip's straps, in the hand
